name: Gilthunder
description: All-Lightning SR character. Essential for the Mines mission where his Lightning Spear adventure skill is required to redirect mine carts. Lance applies Paralysis via Shock combo for powerful damage windows; Sword & Shield provides a reflective Lightning Barrier; Longsword spreads Shock to multiple enemies.

name: Slater
description: An original character with stylish, badass animations. Greatsword leverages Fire Burst for Enhanced Special Attack bursts; Axe builds Bleed stacks for sustained DOT and guaranteed Crits on the Ultimate; Nunchucks is a unique tag-rotation specialist that restores Tag Points on Burst activation and boosts Tag Skill team damage.
